newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST BUX INDEX BASKET WIDENS ON MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST BUX INDEX BASKET WIDENS ON MONDAY.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said it will increase the number of shares the BUX index basket contains to 25 from the current 23, as of September 30.

The BSE will drop agricultural holding company Agrimpex Rt and grocery retailer Global Rt, but will add chemical companies TVK and Borsodchem, hotel firm Eravis and packaging firm Cofinec, the bourse said in a statement.
The BSE finalised the basis price of the new shares today.

Thus the index basket will include Borsodchem, Cofinec, Csopak, Danubius, Domus, Dunaholding, Egis, Eravis, Fotex, Globus, Goldsun, Graboplast, Human, Inter-Europa Bank, MOL, OTP Bank, Pannonplast, Pick, Primagaz, Richter, Skala- Coop T, Styl, TVK, Zalakeramia, Zwack.
The 25 stocks of which the revised BUX will be made up accounts for 97 percent for the capitalization of all shares traded or listed on the BSE, the BSE said earlier this month.
